narrative:
## Handover Summary — COGS Planning

Cost driver models validated across all COGS categories. Gross margin forecast confirmed at 20.8% budget.

## Recommendation for Headcount Phase
Model direct headcount against the Q3 Forecast volume trajectory, starting with Advanced Pilot Training (T-7).

signals.title: Engineering hours, not demand, cap FY2027 revenue — 310 FTE gap at Linköping
signals.source: SDP Engineering Capacity — hours demand from the S&OP plan vs available hours
signals.excerpt: The rate ramp-up needs about 9% more engineering and production hours in FY2027. At current hiring pace Linköping is about 310 FTE short from Q2 2027, which would hold back about SEK 1.1B of revenue.

signals.title: Supply-chain delays would cost SEK 1.8B revenue and SEK 1.17B EBIT in FY2026
signals.source: SDP Scenario Analysis — production rate × escalation × learning curve × supplier inflation
signals.excerpt: A supply-chain delay scenario (hours −6%, learning curve +0.5%, supplier inflation +7%) takes FY2026 net sales from SEK 29.87B to SEK 28.07B and EBIT from SEK 1.67B to SEK 0.51B (1.8% margin), because most programme overhead and OpEx is fixed while hours fall.
